evidence.reason: The post-switch guard in switch() now accepts an empty porcelain status (which occurs when the rendered config matches the target's committed bytes) or the single unstaged CONFIG modification while still rejecting every other change, so a valid same-bytes switch no longer raises after the checkout and config write; tests were not run because the harness permits only git inspection commands.
